name: get_weather
description: Weather data query. query_type defaults to forecast; supports forecast (current weather and forecast), air_quality, historical, marine, climate, and elevation. location is required: pass a city, place name, postal code, or airport code. Do not guess; ask the user when the location is missing.

location.description: Required city, place name, postal code, or airport code. Do not guess; ask the user when it is missing.

query_type.description: Query type. forecast=current weather and forecast, air_quality, historical, marine, climate=climate trends, elevation. Defaults to forecast.

days.description: Number of forecast days, default 3, max 7.

start_date.description: Start date, format YYYY-MM-DD. Used by historical and climate.

end_date.description: End date, format YYYY-MM-DD. Used by historical and climate; defaults to start_date when omitted.

country_code.description: Optional ISO-3166-1 alpha2 country code to disambiguate identically named places, e.g. CN, JP, US.
